status: Post-study corrective validation, specified before run-002. The original cases.json remains unchanged.
contract_basis: The expansion checker accepts exactly compile and functional. Their emitted scopes are compile and real-local-functional-v2 respectively. Complete domain.capture_check records preserve matching stdout, optional parsed labels, and a command_template containing one matching --check argument.

cases.description: Valid functional observation supports the functional contract.
Valid compile observation supports a compile-only test contract, without becoming functional evidence.
A correctly labeled compile observation cannot satisfy the functional contract.
Compile check and commanded compile operation cannot produce functional scope.
Functional check and commanded functional operation cannot produce compile scope, even with a compile-only contract.
A matching invented check label in all representations is not an allowlisted observation producer.
A complete record missing its check label is not admissible.
A list-valued check label is malformed and must be rejected without a crash.
An invented required scope cannot be supported by relabeling a local functional observation.
Local functional observations cannot claim physical-fit support.
The record's functional labels disagree with authoritative stdout labels.
Matching record/stdout labels conflict with the retained cached parsed check label.
Matching record/stdout labels conflict with the retained commanded check.
A purported complete captured record lacks the command_template required by this corrected capture-format contract.
Two --check arguments make command provenance ambiguous.
A trailing --check flag provides no commanded check label.
A correctly labeled applicable functional failure remains contradicted.
An inadmissible record is excluded; an independent valid functional pass still supports the contract.
Two valid functional records with contradictory outcomes remain contradicted.
Authoritative matching stdout and command provenance remain sufficient when the optional cached parsed copy is absent.
